prompt.project_info: Create a six-frame vertical contact sheet collage of car selfies shot with phone flash at night.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult brunette woman with long softly waved hair, warm blush, glossy lips, defined eyeliner, natural skin texture, and a bright red opaque structured top with secure shoulder coverage and light blue jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: 2-column by 3-row contact sheet with thin borders and consistent spacing; six subtle expression and framing variations, cream leather seats, light headliner, night outside, same outfit and interior throughout.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct soft phone flash bounced by cream leather, medium-high contrast, controlled highlights, slight handheld motion blur, glamorous casual nightlife mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical, smartphone 24mm equivalent, f/1.8, face-focused, natural distortion and imperfections, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 6-frame vertical 2-column by 3-row contact sheet of photorealistic car selfies made by an approved adult brunette woman at night. She has long softly waved hair, warm blush, glossy lips, defined eyeliner, and natural skin texture. She wears the same bright red opaque structured top with secure shoulder coverage and light blue jeans in every frame, with gold bracelet, rings, and minimal earrings. Use a cream leather car interior, light headliner, night outside, consistent continuity, thin borders, and subtle changes: high-angle gaze, chest-up neutral portrait, lowered eyes, slight motion blur and smile, closer crop, and wider relaxed seat view. Use a 24mm smartphone lens, f/1.8, direct phone flash bounced from leather, controlled highlights, realistic grain, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, corset, off-shoulder exposure, deep neckline, sexualized pout, nudity, inconsistent outfit, readable logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required layout reference. Preserve six-frame grid, approved-adult identity, red palette, cream interior, flash, and continuity; replace wardrobe with an equally opaque red alternative if needed. Keep all typography and logos absent.

changes: Replaced corset/off-shoulder exposure and sexualized pout with an opaque structured top, secure coverage, and varied natural expressions while preserving the contact-sheet concept.
